name: Sons of the Dragon
lore: Tempered in rift-fire and bound by oaths to the living, the Legion of the Dragon believes strength without mercy is only another Cataclysm. Their Primal Dragon forges flame into a shield for the weak, and into a furnace for those who would prey upon them.

rules.name: Ember Oath
rules.lore: The Sons of the Dragon endure what would break lesser warriors, standing amid infernos to hold the line for those who cannot.
rules.text: +Shattered Legions+ units from your army have !Feel No Pain 6+! against Mortal Damage. In addition, each time a +Shattered Legions+ model from your army makes an attack with a weapon that has the +[Torrent]+ or +[Melta]+ keyword, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

strategems.name: Dragonfire Sweep
strategems.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, ranged weapons equipped by models in the target unit have +[Ignores Cover]+ and +[Torrent]+ weapons have +1 to their =swords= Strength trait.

strategems.name: Hold the Hearth
strategems.when: After an Activated enemy unit declares an attack
strategems.target: A +Shattered Legions+ unit being attacked that is wholly within your deployment zone or within range of an objective marker you control
strategems.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, attacks made against the target unit have their =shield-minus= Armor Break worsened by 1 (to a minimum of 0).

strategems.name: Forged in Flame
strategems.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, models in the target unit have !Feel No Pain 5+!.

spells.name: Cleansing Fire
spells.effect: Select one enemy unit within 18". Roll one d6 for each model in that unit (to a maximum of 10 dice); for each unmodified result of 5+, that unit suffers 1 Mortal Damage.

spells.name: Drake's Resilience
spells.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, one friendly +Legion of the Dragon+ unit within 12" of this +Psyker+ has !Feel No Pain 5+!.

spells.name: Wall of Embers
spells.effect: Select one friendly +Shattered Legions+ unit within 12". Until the end of the Battle Round, that unit has an =shield-plus= Invulnerable Save of 5+ and counts as remaining Stationary for the purpose of shooting even if it moved.

upgrades.name: Ashen Disciple
upgrades.text: At the start of the battle, gain 1 CP.

upgrades.name: Drakehide Mantle
upgrades.text: Your +Warlord+ has an =shield-plus= Invulnerable Save of 5+.

upgrades.name: Eternal Vigil
upgrades.text: While your +Warlord+ is on the Battlefield, friendly +Shattered Legions+ +Infantry+ units wholly within 6" of it have !Feel No Pain 6+!.
